messages:
Maya: Flagging GalaxyHealth Dedicated repro — sessions stuck in generating and per-request token counters climb. Customer captured a small repro and wants urgency.

Asha (CS): Quick context — Dedicated pool `ded-east-1a`, model pinned `rw-instruct-4k:v2026-02-10`, session `sess_gal-7f2b`, user req `gal-20260401-01`. UI spinner, API 202 repeatedly then 500s. Happening under sustained short requests.

Maya: Customer repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/sess_gal-7f2b/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize recent patient visits."}],"max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```
They ran ~40 concurrent short requests; ~60% showed stuck state after a few minutes.

Maya: Customer logs snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-01T09:12:01Z INFO request=gal-20260401-01 worker=worker-17
2026-04-01T09:12:01Z DEBUG session=sess_gal-7f2b kv_cache_len=0
2026-04-01T09:12:22Z WARN request=gal-20260401-01 kv_swap_requested
2026-04-01T09:12:45Z WARN worker=worker-17 kv_swap_latency=2.1s
2026-04-01T09:13:05Z ERROR request=gal-20260401-01 generation_blocked downstream_rpc=timeout
```

Ben (PM): Impact — paying Enterprise customer on Reserved Dedicated. Breaks autosave/sync in clinical UI. Recommend P1. Customer asks for root cause and ETA.

Diego (Eng): Qs before I pick up: 1) Are they using prefix caching or session keepalive? 2) Any special model quantization? 3) Did this start after any config change?

Asha (CS): Customer answers: 1) plain sessions, no prefix reuse, 2) default quant, 3) started ~24h ago after increased parallelism on their side. They can reproduce with our sample curl. Uploaded replay bundle to s3://redwood-triage/galaxyhealth/replay-1726000000.tar.gz

triage-bot: New ticket created ENG-4120 (triage) from customer-success; linked to thread.

Diego (Eng): I'll attempt to replay against our dedicated staging with same model build and pool config. If I see KV swap thrash, I'll add instrumentation for swap frequency and eviction rates. Can someone grant me the sanitized replay creds?

Maya: Shared creds + replay already in S3 — Diego should have access.

Diego (Eng): Repro update: I can reproduce in staging with 30 concurrent short sessions; observed repeated kv_swap_requested and workers entering a slow respawn loop. Hypothesis: aggressive session churn causes repeated KV cache evictions and a serialization point during swap causing request stalls and token counters to increment without progress.

Diego (Eng): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Canary increase `kv_cache_size` for the affected pool to reduce eviction rate, scoped to `ded-east-1a` only. 2) Add transient jitter/backoff in session retry loop to avoid thundering. 3) Add swap telemetry to surface in Console. Need PM and infra signoff for canary.

Ben (PM): Approve canary config change for this pool only. Rollout criteria: 50% reduction in stuck events and token-drift within 30 minutes. Rollback if errors increase or latency SLO regress >10%.

Alex (Sales): GalaxyHealth is evaluating Dedicated expansion — request expedited handling. They can accept a 1-hour maintenance tonight if needed.

Diego (Eng): Timeline: add logging + patch for canary in feature branch (2h), run staging smoke (1h), canary to prod pool (4h) if green. Will attach results to ENG-4120.

Asha (CS): Customer contact Dr. Priya Nair (available 09:00-17:00 ET). Customer asks updates every 2 hours until resolved. I'll send the first update now.

Ben (PM): Product action item: add `Dedicated KV autosizing` to roadmap as a Q3 initiative — reduce manual pool tuning. Assign to Optimize team for scoping.

Diego (Eng): Noted. I'll capture exact reproduction commands, pool config, and worker logs in ENG-4120 for postmortem.

triage-bot: ENG-4120 updated: priority=P1, assignee=diego, sla=enterprise_24h

Maya: Customer replied: "Thanks — please keep us posted. We can throttle on our side until you push a fix." :thumbsup:
